note: McCook County SD publishes parcels only through a Schneider Beacon viewer (not a public ArcGIS REST service); county site links no GIS service and points to the Equalization office by email/phone. SD state sdgis.sd.gov services have no McCook parcels. The only ArcGIS parcel layer found (Regrid nationwide MapServer) returns 404 on query. Commercial downloads (Equator, Regrid store, Rockford) are not county-published.
